_doc: Posting queue. status: building -> needs-voice -> ready -> sent. At each slot (11:45 + 18:45 ET) the oldest 'ready' item per channel is sent to the user with its caption, then marked 'sent'. No ready item = slot skipped, never filler. Final mp4s live in posting/ready/ (committed: they carry paid voice).

items.title: The 1% fee that eats 24% of your retirement
items.caption: 1% sounds like nothing. Over 40 years it quietly takes a quarter of your money. Here's the math.

items.title: A raise can't lower your pay (the tax bracket myth)
items.caption: Getting bumped into the 22% bracket doesn't put your whole paycheck at 22%. Only the dollars above the line. Here's the math on a $1,000 raise.

items.title: The minimum payment trap: $5,000, 19 years
items.caption: Pay only the minimum on a $5,000 card at 22% and it takes 19 years and $8,100 in interest. Keep paying that first payment instead and it's gone in under 5.

items.title: Lose 20%, gain 20%... you're still down
items.caption: $10,000 drops 20% to $8,000. A 20% gain only gets you to $9,600. You need 25% just to break even, and a 50% loss needs 100%.

items.title: Switching doors doubles your odds (it feels wrong)
items.caption: Three doors, one car. Switching wins 2 out of 3 times. Your gut says 50/50. Your gut is wrong.

items.title: Africa is 14x bigger than Greenland. Your map lied.
items.caption: On the map on your wall they look the same size. They are not even close.

items.title: Astronauts aren't weightless. They're falling.
items.caption: Gravity on the space station is about 90% of what you feel right now. So why do they float?

items.title: Multiply any number by 11 in your head
items.caption: No calculator, two seconds. Pause and try 72 x 11 first.
